summary: Polestar Automotive Holding UK PLC filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, to furnish materials related to its upcoming annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for June 26, 2026. The filing includes the notice of AGM, depositary notice to ADS holders, voting instruction cards, and a press release announcing the AGM date. It also references the publication of the company's UK annual report for the year ended December 31, 2025. No unusual or special-situation corporate actions—such as acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, going-private transactions, or management changes—are announced or implied. This is a routine administrative filing for an ordinary shareholder meeting.
